mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a broad-based economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS are above their 1-year moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2%, the market prices in an imminent Fed rate hike, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high payroll growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tight labor market that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) are growing rapidly but GDP growth (GDPC1) is weak, it signals a fragile recovery that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5% and GDPC1 growth < 1.5%.
